import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    return -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A) + p[4]*A**p[5]*np.exp(-p[6]*t) + p[7]*t**p[8]*A**p[9]
